step1_analysis.description: A fully differential telescopic cascode amplifier used as a gain stage or FIR filter tap in a decision-feedback equalizer. It features an NMOS input differential pair, NMOS cascodes, and PMOS cascode active loads.

paper_reference.title: An Adaptive Analog Noise-Predictive Decision-Feedback Equalizer

dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * (Rout || R_cmfb). gm ~ 666uS, Rout ~ 90kOhm -> Gain ~ 60 V/V = 35 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 2 dB is likely the loaded tap weight in the FIR filter. The unloaded core amplifier will have a much higher gain typical of a telescopic cascode.

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cload). Rout ~ 90kOhm, Cload = 10fF -> BW ~ 176 MHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the high output impedance of the cascode and the load capacitance. Lower gain configurations would push this closer to the paper's 800 MHz.

power.description: Total power consumption of the stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports total chip power (130 mW). A single amplifier tap consumes a small fraction of that.

delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by slew rate and RC time constant. ~ 0.35 / BW = 0.35 / 176MHz = 2 ns
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported delay well, consistent with the bandwidth.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for Telescopic Cascode Amplifier measuring gain, bandwidth, power, and delay. Includes ideal CMFB resistors to stabilize the operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Adaptive Analog Noise-Predictive Decision-Feedback Equalizer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM2 N10 N02 N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUTP VGG N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N14 N01 N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 VOUTN N12 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUTN N7 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N8 VBB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VOUTP VGG N14 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N11 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biasing
VVBB VBB 0 0.99
VN6 N6 0 0.99
VVGG VGG 0 0.85
VN7 N7 0 0.85
VN12 N12 0 0.85

* Tail current source
Itail N13 0 80u

* Inputs
VVINP N01 0 DC 0.6 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.55 0.65 1n 10p 10p 2n 4n)
VVINN N02 0 DC 0.6 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.65 0.55 1n 10p 10p 2n 4n)

* Load capacitance
CL1 VOUTP 0 10f
CL2 VOUTN 0 10f

* Ideal CMFB to stabilize DC operating point
VCM_REF VCM 0 0.9
RCM1 VOUTP VCM 1Meg
RCM2 VOUTN VCM 1Meg

* Differential output
E_diff VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUTN VOUTP 1

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT_DIFF))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  let gain_minus_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_minus_3db fall=1
  
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran delay trig v(N01) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
